description: Samantha, a boxing kangaroo animatronic with artist-made art: an original enemy who shuffles in a boxer's stance, throws jabs, a one-two-hook, an overhand haymaker and a tail kick, and pins the player for a four-phase punching grab. Spawn her on the "Sandbox: Samantha" stage from the Sandbox Extras pack (saintpeverell.sandbox-extras). In game 2.2.3 she also comes to Furry Entertainment Robotics, from its Jenny and Sunny spawners: from wave 3 once the game's minimum-wave fix is out, from wave 1 on 2.2.3 itself.
